title: Navimower 0.4.1

## Highlights

Navimower 0.4.1 is a cumulative reliability and data-correctness release built directly on 0.4.0. It combines the field-tested 0.4.1 beta work into one normal release; the individual beta versions do not need to be installed first.

### Notifications and errors

- Adds **Latest notification**, using the Navimow app's read-only Notification -> Device feed. It keeps up to five recent normalized messages, preserves vendor codes as strings (including values such as `150A`), retains the vendor read flag and never marks messages read.
- Vendor-native notification jump URLs are deliberately not retained or exposed.
- Improves state handling for **Idle**, **Lifted** and numeric faults.
- Keeps **Problem** as the active problem/safety indicator while **Error** exposes vendor fault detail when a live numeric error object is reported.
- Numeric fault field captures such as `6108` (Mower got stuck) and `6106` (Motion planning error) provide their vendor title/content directly. Lifted remains a separate safety state and no numeric code is invented for it.
- Notification history and live Problem/Error state remain separate sources; 0.4.1 does not assume that every mower fault also appears in the Device notification feed.

### Telemetry, history and positioning

- Prevents dense MQTT position updates from starving private-cloud polling, keeping settings, schedule, coverage and cloud state current during active mowing.
- Keeps useful MQTT state/progress traffic alive if the pose stream degrades instead of rebuilding the whole MQTT client solely because position is missing.
- Publishes Task progress/area and Map coverage/area from their appropriate current vendor sources instead of rewriting them through retained history.
- Keeps physical mower position separate from the zone that owns current task progress.
- Keeps multi-zone mowing together as one logical history session while treating confirmed zone-cycle resets as per-zone boundaries.
- Deduplicates repeated vendor poses and uses the mower's reported mowing-path width for completed-session footprints when available.
- Adds freshness-aware private-cloud X/Y fallback for Current physical zone and Current channel. Gate close/clear decisions through cloud fallback require two distinct fresh vendor position reports.

### Settings and model support

- **Night mowing**, **Rain** and **Rain sensor** now write robot-first and then persist the existing legacy cloud value. All three were field-tested bidirectionally on H215 and remain persistent.
- Cutting-height handling no longer turns unknown encoded values into invented millimetres or disables otherwise valid mower-level support.
- Adds the initial **i2 AWD** capability profile, including observed i208 AWD controls and Global cutting height where supported.

> [!CAUTION]
> i2 AWD support is **experimental and has not yet been field-tested on a live i2 AWD mower through Navimower**. The controls are intentionally included for testing, but availability, labels and write semantics can vary by firmware.

### Diagnostics cleanup

- Home Assistant's normal **Download diagnostics** is now the supported diagnostics path. It remains sanitized, read-only and focused on useful mower, connectivity, positioning, map/history, telemetry, Problem/Error and latest-notification context.
- Removes the beta-only Passive protocol discovery and Diagnostics detail options.
- Removes the development-only `navimower.export_diagnostics` and `navimower.mark_discovery_event` actions and beta capture/probe inventories from the production diagnostics interface.
- Notifications and the production Error/Problem runtime are unchanged by this cleanup.

### Legacy Map Camera

The built-in SVG camera remains available in 0.4.1 as **Legacy Map Camera** for compatibility. Navimower Map Card is the supported map UI going forward.

**Legacy Map Camera is scheduled for removal in Navimower 0.4.2.** The development beta line will remove it starting with 0.4.2-beta1, so migrate dashboards to Navimower Map Card before upgrading to 0.4.2.

No config-entry, map-history or entity-unique-ID migration is required for the 0.4.0 -> 0.4.1 upgrade.
